description: Italian passage-breakdown learning path: the SOURCE passage (paragraph, story, exam item, or movie/play script) is the syllabus. One chapter per coherent chunk; each is dissected with an interlinear `annotated-passage` widget whose grammar layers (articles, nouns, verbs, adverbs, preps, pronouns, translation, literal) toggle on/off independently. When the passage is domain text (e.g. medicine) a parallel `concept` layer teaches the subject behind the language; when it is a dialogue-script a `subtext` layer teaches speaker intent.

passageReadings._doc: Every passage lesson opens with TWO full readings of the source passage, surfaced in the lesson audio player. Emitted as audio-scripts.json `sections`: passage-fast and passage-slow. The bake applies pitch-preserved atempo to any section with speed<1.0. NOTE: Dia (engine:dia) is ENGLISH-ONLY — it emits a drone/garbage on Italian — so `language-it` slow reads use engine:omni (Lucrezia, same voice, slowed). engine:dia is reserved for an English-domain different-voice slow read.
